title: After editing src/, the first prompt pays for replacing the resident
trigger: after editing src/ in a DD checkout during a session that uses DD
behavior_delta: Expect the next prompt after a src/ edit to have no recall: the stale resident refuses it, that prompt replaces it, and the model loads before later prompts are answered. To avoid losing that prompt, restart it directly by piping a session-start payload into node hooks/run.cjs session-start (a detached spawn from the Bash tool dies with the tool call), and reconnect the MCP server with /mcp, whose answers say when its code is stale.
what: Expect the next prompt after a src/ edit to have no recall: the stale resident refuses it, that prompt replaces it, and the model loads before later prompts are answered. To avoid losing that prompt, restart it directly by piping a session-start payload into node hooks/run.cjs session-start (a detached spawn from the Bash tool dies with the tool call), and reconnect the MCP server with /mcp, whose answers say when its code is stale.
why: The resident fingerprints src/ and refuses hooks once it changes. Until 2026-09-24 only a session start replaced it, which left long stretches without recall; the prompt hook now replaces it, but only after one prompt has gone unanswered.

evidence_refs.summary: Prompt path calls ensureResident when the bridge does not answer.
MCP answers carry a reconnect notice once the source tree changed.
